messages:
Nina (CS): Heads-up: Greenfold Systems wants to shorten renewal to 6 months and pay via PO with Net45. PO id GF-0626 came in but vendor code is for their US parent while we bill to Redwood Ltd (UK). They asked if we can accept and invoice to parent. cc @Carlos (AE)

Carlos (AE): Procurement says parent company will sign but they want invoice to their US entity for AP simplicity. Customer prefers Net45 this quarter to match their quarter close. Any objections besides bookkeeping?

Mei (Finance): Finance: invoicing to a different legal entity requires either an entity assignment memo or a signed billing ack from their parent agreeing Redwood Ltd can invoice them. Otherwise we can't book revenue to the UK entity. Options: corrected PO, signed billing ack, or a 20% prepayment.

Alan (Legal): Legal: We can prepare a short "Billing Acknowledgment" form that parent signs, confirming responsibility. That plus the PO referencing SOW GF-SOW-06 would be sufficient. If they refuse, insist on prepayment.

Devon (SE): For onboarding impact: if payment clears within 30 days we'll provision normally. If not, recommend limited throughput (no reserved GPUs) — can still do integration testing.

Nina (CS): I'm proposing we present two paths to Greenfold: 1) sign billing ack + PO with SOW ref => full provisioning + Net45, or 2) 20% prepay now => limited provisioning until PO final. Which is preferred?

Carlos (AE): Customer PM says they can get parent sign-off on ack today. I'll send the bill-ack template and ask them to return signed.

payments-bot: Draft invoice created GF-0626 (draft) - awaiting billing ack or prepayment. Link: https://pay.redwood.example/invoices/draft/GF-0626

Mei (Finance): If we go with billing ack, I'll still place an invoice hold until signed ack and matching PO are in our system. Collections will follow Net45 schedule once documents are uploaded.

Alan (Legal): Uploaded billing ack template to legal repo and emailed to carlos@greenfold.com. Noted late fees at 1% per 30 days in addendum.

Carlos (AE): Greenfold PM confirmed signature on ack via email and attached signed PO referencing GF-SOW-06. Forwarded to payments@redwood.

payments-bot: Received documents. Invoice GF-0626 posted (Net45). Notifications scheduled (D30, D40). Link: https://pay.redwood.example/invoices/GF-0626

Mei (Finance): Credit hold cleared. Revenue recognition will follow posted invoice. Please confirm provisioning mode.

Devon (SE): Full provisioning approved. Scheduling dedicated pool for onboarding week of Jul 5. I'll notify infra.

Nina (CS): All set. Tracker updated: Greenfold Systems A status=Committed, term=6mo, payment=Net45 via PO GF-0626. Closing thread. :tada:
